Karansul's domain

Here one can find numerous workshops owned by the merchant Karansul. His lieutenants control almost the whole area except the narrow valleys between the mountain spurs. A while ago there was a laboratory of Canian Warrior Magicians here, but after one of their usual miscalculations these valleys became lethal.
